system.longDesc:
Cost: 2 SP

NOTE: You may only choose stunts from this list when you earn the SP while making an attack with a gun. Some gun stunts require a specific type of gun, such as a pistol, rifle, or automatic weapon.

Make a second attack against the same target or a different one within 5 meters of the first; take a 2 to this attack roll, but gain a +2 to the damage roll if you hit. Immediately check ammo against Capacity afterward.
